earlier_sources: https://github.com/googlefonts/googlefontdirectory-hg at 52f780bc9d197280a9f430574e179a5f233c56b6, ofl/nanumgothic/: the font as built and its metadata; src/ holds METADATA_comments.txt, no source.
disclose: The released fonts are partly hinted (TrueType instructions in 4462 to 4839 of 13297 to 13671 glyphs per style). These sources carry no TrueType instructions, so the build is hinted by ttfautohint: the outlines, spacing and layout are the releases', its rendering at small sizes under a TrueType interpreter is not. Hinting is not compared by the gates.
